report.method: HSLuv expansion of the final Step 7 RGB table, retaining all 120 exact anchors. Interpolate 24 intermediate families in ring-specific HSLuv; add gamut-cusp exemplars, perceptual shade/tint subdivisions and constant-lightness muted companions. Three added inner shades and one outer tint replace the v1 two-inner/two-outer allocation.
report.attribution: Source wheel and 120 named RGB anchors: Warren Mars. HSLuv: Alexei Boronine and contributors. Expansion and interpolation rules: Gamut Forge. Independent extension, not an official Martian wheel.
report.source_section: Step 7 — Reinstate the full brightness and final adjustments
report.vivid_rule: Interpolate source exemplar HSLuv hue by the shortest arc, find the maximum CIELUV chroma over lightness at that hue, and place this gamut cusp at the closest of the five ring lightnesses before subdivision. Original exemplars are retained exactly.
report.source_value_policy: Published RGB triples are authoritative for this expansion; rounded or inconsistent printed HSV values are retained as source metadata, not recomputed over the RGB.
report.ramp_rule: Interpolate shortest-arc HSLuv hue, relative-gamut saturation and CIELUV lightness between the five source rings and at their four midpoints. Three inner shades use 0.35, 0.50 and 0.65 times the darkest L*. One outer tint is halfway from the lightest L* to 100. Extensions retain the endpoint hue and HSLuv saturation.
report.muted_rule: At ring coordinates 0.5, 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5, multiply HSLuv S by 0.4 and 0.7 at unchanged L*. Bend H toward the lightest-tint H by 1 minus the saturation multiplier. This continuation of source hue bends is our extension.
report.gray_rule: 16 neutrals evenly spaced in L*: 0,100/15,...,100, using HSLuv conversion and nearest-byte rounding.
report.diagram: Ring position follows the authored shade/tint sequence, not globally constant lightness. Three added dark rings, nine source/interpolated rings, one added light ring. Outlined cells are exact source anchors.
